title: Wooden Block Blast Master
description: Wooden Block Blast Adventure Master is a fun block elimination puzzle game! It is ideal for you when you want to kill time and challenge your brain. In Wooden Block Blast Adventure Master, you need to clear as many colored blocks as possible to get a high score. Mastering the skill of filling rows or columns will make the puzzle game easier. Multiple game modes to challenge your limit! If you are a puzzle game lover, dont miss it!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
